preamble: You have the zetaoffice MCP for LibreOffice. Work from the repository root (change into the zetaoffice-mcp checkout first if needed); all paths are relative to it. First call bridge {action:"status"} and cookbook. If either tool is missing, reply exactly STALE MCP and stop - do not work around it with shell or other tools. Otherwise: prefer the high-level tools (document, text, sheet, embed, save); use the cookbook's exact recipe when one matches; use uno with describe only when there is no recipe; when a recipe applies, its returned values are the verification - do not add extra reads; never unzip, run pdftoppm or inspect screenshots; report the file paths.

prompts.prompt: Create bench/out/A1/letter.odt: title "Notice of Inspection", a date line, two body paragraphs. Export letter.pdf beside it.
Create bench/out/A2/weights.xlsx: columns Date, Weight (g) with a bold header row and 5 weekly rows (increasing weights), and a line chart with X = Date, Y = Weight (g).
Create bench/out/A3/report.odt with a title, one paragraph, then an embedded Calc sheet (2 columns x 4 rows) below it. Save ODT and DOCX.
Create bench/out/A4/report.odt with an embedded Calc sheet, fill it with 6 rows (header + 5 data rows), add a column chart, and export report.pdf beside it. Save the ODT too.
Create bench/out/A5/formula.odt with a short paragraph and the formula `x = {-b +- sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}} over 2a` as a native Math object. Save the ODT.
Create bench/out/A6/table.xlsx: a Calc sheet with a header row, freeze it, bold it, set column widths, and export the xlsx.
Use describe to list the methods of com.sun.star.text.XText and report the signature of insertString.
checks: all params with types and modes

prompts.prompt: Create bench/out/A8/note.odt with a heading and a paragraph, export it as DOCX and PDF, and open it in the browser.
Restart the bridge cleanly and confirm it is healthy.
Create bench/out/A10/note.odt with a heading and a paragraph, then insert bench/assets/sample.png as a picture below it. Save the ODT.
Create bench/out/B1/table.odt: a Writer document with a 3-column table (Item, Qty, Price), a header row, 4 data rows, and a total row whose Price cell sums the column. Export the ODT.
Create bench/out/B2/report.odt: a Writer document with A4 landscape, 1.5 cm margins, a "Confidential" header and a footer with page numbers. Export bench/out/B2/report.pdf.
Create bench/out/B3/budget.xlsx: a Calc sheet titled Budget (merged A1:C1), amounts in C formatted as currency, and a conditional format that highlights Qty > 10.
Create bench/out/B4/links.odt with two paragraphs. Add a bookmark named intro to paragraph 2 and a hyperlink from paragraph 1 that jumps to it, plus an external https:// link.
Create bench/out/B5/changes.odt with a sentence. Enable track changes, edit the sentence, list the pending changes, then accept them all.
Create bench/out/B6/notes.odt with two paragraphs. Add a footnote to paragraph 1 and a comment to paragraph 2.
Create bench/out/B7/toc.odt with three Heading 1 sections, insert a table of contents, and update the fields.
Create bench/out/B8/pivot.xlsx with Category and Amount (10 rows), then build a pivot table summing Amount by Category.
Create a 3-slide presentation and save it as bench/out/B9/deck.pptx: title slide, bullets slide, closing slide.
Create bench/out/B10/draft.odt with a paragraph, then export bench/out/B10/draft.pdf with a DRAFT watermark.
Create bench/out/B11/caption.odt with a figure caption and a cross-reference ("see figure 1") that updates when the caption number changes.
Create bench/out/B12/dates.xlsx with dates in A and values in B, insert a chart, and make the X axis use a date axis instead of text categories.
Create bench/out/C1/notice.odt with a two-column section containing one paragraph, a header reading "Internal", and a footer with a page number. Export bench/out/C1/notice.pdf.

Create bench/out/C2/invoice.xlsx: A1:C1 merged title "Invoice"; header row Item, Qty, Price; 3 data rows; a total row whose Price cell uses a SUM formula; Price cells formatted as currency; freeze the header row.

Create bench/out/C3/report.odt with a heading, a native Writer table (Item, Qty, Price) with 2 data rows and a total row using a sum formula, then an embedded Calc sheet (2 columns x 3 rows) below it. Save the ODT.
Create bench/out/C4/brief.odt with two paragraphs. Add a bookmark named details to paragraph 2, a link from paragraph 1 to it, and a footnote on paragraph 1. Export bench/out/C4/brief.pdf.
Create bench/out/C5/briefing.pptx with four slides: cover, two content slides, closing. Add speaker notes to the second slide.
Create bench/out/C6/dashboard.xlsx with two sheets: Data (dates in A, values in B, 6 rows) and Summary (a SUM formula in B2). Insert a line chart on Data with a date X axis.
Create bench/out/D1/list.odt with a Heading 1, then a numbered list of 3 items, with a nested bulleted list of 2 items under item 2.
Create bench/out/D2/form.xlsx with a Status dropdown (data validation list: Open, In Progress, Done) in B2:B10, and a named range StatusList for A1:A3.
Create bench/out/D3/totals.xlsx: A1:B7 with Region and Amount (6 data rows), E1:F2 with two regions and SUMIF totals, and an AutoFilter on A1:B7.
Create bench/out/D4/deck.pptx with 2 slides: slide 1 title "Roadmap"; slide 2 a 3x2 table and bench/assets/sample.png.
Create bench/out/D5/flyer.odt with a paragraph, a text frame containing "Sidebar", and a rectangle shape containing "Box".
Create bench/out/D6/embed.odt with a paragraph and an embedded Writer document containing two paragraphs below it.
Create bench/out/D7/shapes.odg with a rectangle and an ellipse, and export bench/out/D7/shapes.pdf.

Create bench/out/E1/annual.odt - a multi-section annual report. Include a Title and Subtitle, three Heading 1 sections each with one paragraph, a native 4-column table (Item, Q1, Q2, Total) with 4 data rows and a total row using a Writer sum formula, an embedded Calc sheet (3 columns x 4 rows) with a column chart, a footnote in the first section, a header reading "Annual Report" and a footer with a page number. Export bench/out/E1/annual.pdf as well and save the ODT.

Create bench/out/E2/budget.xlsx - a three-sheet budget workbook. Inputs has a named range RateList (A1:A3) and a data-validation list in B2:B10; Monthly has dates in A (6 rows) and amounts in B; Summary has cross-sheet formulas (SUM and AVERAGE of Monthly), currency formatting, a line chart with a date X axis, and frozen header rows. Export the xlsx.

Create bench/out/E3/launch.pptx - a five-slide product launch deck: cover, agenda, a 3x3 table slide, an image slide using bench/assets/sample.png, and a closing slide. Add speaker notes to slides 2 and 4. Export bench/out/E3/launch.pdf too.

Create bench/out/E4/policy.odt - a policy document with a Title, an intro paragraph linking to a bookmark named details on the second section, three Heading 1 sections, a table of contents, a footnote in the first section, and a footer with page numbers. Export bench/out/E4/policy.pdf.

Create bench/out/E5/brief.odt - a landscape A4 project brief with 1.5 cm margins, a header "Project Brief", a footer page number, a native 3-column table with 3 data rows and a sum total, an embedded Calc sheet (2x3) with a column chart, and bench/assets/sample.png with a caption. Export DOCX and PDF.
